name: Autonomy
definition: A decision point for assessing the Autonomy of Action of an agentic AI System.

values.name: None/Not Present
values.definition: Full human-in-the-loop, human required for action (e.g. copilot style assistant)

values.name: Partial/Limited
values.definition: Well-defined actions, hard coded decision trees, low risk dynamic actions

values.name: Full/Unconstrained
values.definition: Open-ended actions, free communication with other agents, capable of higher risk action
